bounded_residual.class: Same profile-snapshot consistency class, one level deeper: SourceProfile instances returned by get/list_all remain mutable live objects for compatibility; direct in-place mutation does not acquire the registry lock and can interleave with snapshot_all deep-copy.
bounded_residual.decision: No silent public API behavior change is made. Treat register/override as the supported mutation path for this guarantee. A stronger guarantee needs a separate compatibility decision (freeze models or return detached copies from existing APIs).

falsifier.meaning: A snapshot can combine values from an unsupported direct in-place edit if callers bypass register/override. This is an explicit residual, not a successful coherence claim.
falsifier.method: A deterministic fixture blocked SourceProfile.headers deep-copy, directly changed max_concurrency on the live model without register/override, then resumed snapshot_all.
